notes.glasses: Thick frames forbidden. Must not reflect flash. Tinted glasses forbidden.
notes.smile: Neutral expression, mouth closed, direct gaze, no teeth shown.
notes.ears: Head bare without accessories. Hair must not conceal face or forehead.
notes.shadows: Strictly even light, no shadow on background or cheeks.
notes.babyRules: Infants: eyes must be open, head straight, no pacifiers, toys or visible parent hands.
